_notes.title: The game's name, shown in the header and at the top of the share grid.
_notes.topic: One line about what the words are, shown under the name and on the how-to-play sheet.
_notes.words: The answers in play order, one a day: five letters each, letters only. Write 60 to 365 on the topic.
_notes.launchDate: YYYY-MM-DD. Day 1 is this date; each later day plays the next word, and the list starts over at its end.
_notes.allowExtra: Extra guesses the game should accept that are not everyday English: names, jargon, in-jokes. Five letters each.
_notes.theme: paper (cool paper, ink, and sage), night (deep green with emerald and amber light), or candy (bubblegum, mint, and sunshine). Each has a light and a dark side that follows the device.
_notes.hardMode: true starts every game in hard mode, where every letter you've found must be used again. Players can change it in settings.
